messages:
alex: Quick sync — product wants to retire the alias `redwood-lite` next month. We need a tiny migration doc + mapping table, update SDK snippets (streaming + tool calling), and a short comms blurb for the changelog.
maria: Ack. Can we keep a short compatibility table and an automated redirect? :thinking_face:
sam: Redirects are fine, but we should also provide explicit examples for both REST + JS SDK. Lots of customers using the alias in sample apps.
kevin: I can add a server-side redirect rule. Docs team: what format do you want the mapping in? CSV, markdown table?
lena: Markdown table is best for the guide. Also need a snippet that shows how to map old alias to new model in code, like `if (alias) -> modelMap[alias]`.
alex: Good. Draft plan: 1) Small doc page "Alias retirement guide" with mapping table and FAQs. 2) Update 4 code samples (python, js sync, js streaming, curl). 3) Add a changelog blurb + redirect. 4) PR checklist and owners.
maria: I'll draft the markdown table and initial FAQ. Putting it in a branch `docs/alias-retire-2151`.
sam: For the JS streaming sample, we should show both the old alias path and the explicit model param. Example snippet:

```js
// before
const res = await client.chat.completions.create({ model: 'redwood-lite', input });

// after
const res = await client.chat.completions.create({ model: 'rw-model-small-v2', input });
```

Also include a tiny helper map:

```js
const aliasMap = { 'redwood-lite': 'rw-model-small-v2' };
const model = aliasMap[requested] || requested;
```

kevin: Perfect. Can you keep streaming/kv-cache notes short? Ops needs to know if memory/kv behavior changes with v2.
lena: Add a note: "If you relied on alias to auto-select quantized variant, pin `-q4` variants explicitly now." Short and bold.

maria: Draft pushed: https://git.company/redwood/docs/pull/842 (WIP). I added mapping table and FAQ Qs: rollout window, telemetry, and guide for testing.

alex: Nice. Docs-bot, can you add a checklist entry for updating SDK examples in the sample-app repo?
docs-bot: Added TODO: update sample-app JS + Python snippets, update docs redirects, add changelog entry. Assigned to @maria and @sam. :white_check_mark:

sam: I'll take the JS streaming + curl examples. @kevin can you handle redirect rule and a temporary compatibility banner on the docs page?
kevin: Yep. I'll create the redirect and banner config. Will target next deploy (Thu).

lena: One more: add a short section in the guide for customers who used alias-based rollouts explaining how to map rollout weights to explicit model versions.

alex: Good call. Also capture a tiny rollback plan: if any regressions, we revert docs redirect and restore alias for 48h while we patch.
maria: Updated PR with rollback note and banner screenshot. Ready for review.

sam: Quick QA checklist I added in the PR:
- [ ] update live samples in sample-app
- [ ] run model comparison prompts from /docs/migration/tests
- [ ] smoke test streaming latency
- [ ] confirm redirects 301 -> new page

alex: Thanks team. We'll aim to merge by Tue to give a week notice before retirement. If anyone finds edge-case language issues, comment on the PR. :pray:
